## Goal
- Execute the IVX 24/7 autonomous development mandate: 12 workers (W1–W12), 2-hour evidence-backed reports, complete the existing IVX platform to enterprise quality, Owner Auth Guardian + continuous QA + live Autonomous Dashboard on real ledger data, SMS owner alerts, then app-from-scratch capability (W12/P2).

## Constraints & Preferences
- 12-worker model W1–W12 (Architecture, Auth, Security, Mobile, Backend, Database, Chat/Reels/Media, Owner Platform, QA, Deployment, Performance, App Generation) + permanent IVX OWNER AUTH GUARDIAN worker
- Reports every 2 hours with completed/running/blocked, commits, deployments, tests, security, auth status, APK/iOS/production status, enterprise readiness, next plan
- Automatic QA cadence mandated: health every 5m, auth API + protected routes every 15m, full auth matrix every 2h, release QA per release, device certification before prod approval
- Dashboard must use real ledger data (stable job IDs, evidence, timestamps), no seed data; dedicated Owner Authentication section required
- SMS alerts to owner phone 561-644-3503 only for genuine owner action; format "IVX ALERT\nSeverity:/Incident:/Area:/Problem:/Owner Action:/Dashboard URL:/Status:"; never include secrets; verify provider at runtime, store MessageId, log every SMS; on failure return Provider/Variable Checked/HTTP Status/Error Code/Safe Error/Required Correction
- Never mark VERIFIED without production evidence; owner approval only for credential rotation, destructive ops, high-risk migrations, DNS, payments, prod releases per policy, risky rollback
- Owner token (~15 min TTL): `POST https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login` body `{"email":"iperez4242@gmail.com"}` → `accessToken` (len 1540); stored `/tmp/owner_token`
- `POST /api/ivx/developer-deploy/action`: top-level `{action, confirm:true, confirmText, reason, input:{...}}`; confirmTexts `CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE`, `CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_MERGE`, `CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY`, `CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_SERVICE_UPDATE`, `CONFIRM_IVX_SUPABASE_MIGRATION`
- Cloudflare WAF blocks deploy payloads ≥~100–200KB (403 HTML) — cannot re-commit `backend/hono.ts` (306KB)
- Use `bun`/`bunx`; parse-check with `bun build <file> --target=bun --packages external`
- Owner explicitly stated focus is **Expo Go native** (`expo/` dir); Swift Command Center secondary (owner interrupted an iOS OwnerAuthView write)

## Progress
### Done
- **JOB-0015 VERIFIED** — job-ledger API + Expo dashboard end-to-end: `backend/api/ivx-autonomous-job-ledger.ts` live (`GET /api/ivx/autonomous/ledger`, `POST /api/ivx/autonomous/ledger/update`), durable store `logs/audit/autonomous-job-ledger/ledger.json`, marker `ivx-autonomous-job-ledger-2026-07-17`; commits `24fc272`, `d7153a0`, `6bdadf4`, `7002a4c` (Expo dashboard route `/autonomous-dashboard`)
- **JOB-0027 VERIFIED (W2/P0)** — Owner Auth Guardian live: `backend/api/ivx-owner-auth-guardian.ts` — `GET /api/ivx/autonomous/auth-guardian` (live probes each read: api_health, supabase_auth, protected_route_guard 401 check, owner_login_route 4xx check; auto incidents INC-xxxx; 12-component auth map route→file→function; SMS provider runtime status) + `POST .../alert`; state `logs/audit/owner-auth-guardian/state.json`; marker `ivx-owner-auth-guardian-2026-07-17`; commits `3cdabba0`, `f03a3f18`; live proof: no-token 401, owner GET 200 HEALTHY 4/4 probes
- **JOB-0028 DONE (W8/P1)** — Owner Authentication section in `expo/app/autonomous-dashboard.tsx` (guardian probes/incidents/SMS provider/recent alerts) committed `b0900387`; on-device verify pending next APK
- **Ledger job-creation support (W1)** — `POST .../ledger/update` now accepts `create:true` + workerId/title/priority/evidence/blocker for new JOB-xxxx ids (regex `JOB-\d{4}`), and patches evidence/blocker on updates; commit `141e3c0f`, deployed & live-verified (JOB-0027/0028/0029 created; ledger version 5; counts: 29 jobs, verified 10, running 3, blocked 4, ownerActionRequired 4, queued 8, pendingApprovals 5)
- **JOB-0029 registered (W3/P0, OWNER_ACTION_REQUIRED)** — SMS runtime-verified honest failure: test alert 502 `missing_config`, missing `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID`/`AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` on Render; ALERT-0001 logged; phone `+1***3503`
- **JOB-0030 (W9) — Continuous QA scheduler DEPLOYED & production-verified**: new `backend/api/ivx-auth-qa-scheduler.ts` (marker `ivx-auth-qa-scheduler-2026-07-17`) — in-process intervals health 5m / auth 15m / matrix 2h, immediate first ticks, state `logs/audit/autonomous-qa/state.json`, QA-xxxxx run log (max 60), shares guardian incident state via exported `runAuthProbes`/`reconcileIncidents` (now returns newly-opened incidents), auto SMS alert on new incident when provider ready; route `GET /api/ivx/autonomous/qa` owner-only; guardian exports commit `99eb38de4`, scheduler `64345845a`, hono-extended `347366c72`; first deploy raced HEAD (`99eb38de4`), re-deploy fixed → live verify: no-token 401, owner GET 200 `schedulerRunning:true`, healthOk/authOk true, QA-00001 health `HTTP 200 in 987ms`, QA-00002 matrix `4/4 probes ok`
- Reports #1–#4 delivered; arm64 APK v1.4.6(38) SHA `0b7ced1b…894c7` delivered (predates dashboard screen)
- Enterprise readiness last reported 6/10

### In Progress
- Continuous QA section added to `expo/app/autonomous-dashboard.tsx` (QA_URL const, QAResponse types, parallel guardian+qa fetch, Continuous QA card before Jobs card, qaStatusRow styles) — parse-check passed, **not yet committed via deploy API**
- Pending this window: commit Expo dashboard update, retry password reset email (was 429), register JOB-0030 in ledger, deliver 2-hour report

### Blocked
- SMS alerts: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY missing on Render (proven 502 missing_config) — owner must set env vars (JOB-0029)
- P0 password reset email: `/auth/v1/recover` 429 `over_email_send_rate_limit`
- Service-role key rotation (APR-001): owner Supabase action
- Physical Android QA (JOB-0010): owner device required
- CI workflow registration (JOB-0012): GitHub token lacks workflow scope (APR-004)
- DB backup verification (JOB-0011): backend missing SUPABASE_DB_URL/DATABASE_URL (APR-005)
- Release keystore (APR-003/JOB-0008): owner approval required
- Dashboard + auth/QA sections in repo but not on-device until next APK build

## Key Decisions
- Route extension layer `backend/hono-extended.ts` (imports `./hono`, registers routes; `server.ts` imports it) to bypass WAF size limit — hosts ledger + guardian + qa routes; calls `startAutonomousQAScheduler()` on boot (idempotent via `globalThis.__ivxQASchedulerStarted`)
- Guardian runs live probes on every GET (no cached green); incidents auto-open/close durably; QA scheduler reuses same guardian state file so guardian/dashboard/scheduler share one incident ledger
- SMS transport reuses `backend/services/ivx-sns-sms.ts` (AWS SNS, senderId IVXOwner); phone fallback `+15616443503` hardcoded, env override supported
- Ledger new-job creation gated: owner-only, `create:true`, valid worker, JOB-xxxx id format
- Render deploy sometimes races GitHub HEAD — poll `/health` `seniorDeveloperRuntime.commitSha`, re-trigger deploy if stale
- iOS Command Center guardian wiring (GuardianService.swift written; OwnerAuthView.swift write interrupted by owner) deprioritized in favor of Expo Go native

## Next Steps
1. Commit updated `expo/app/autonomous-dashboard.tsx` (Continuous QA section) via deploy API (`github_commit_file`)
2. Register JOB-0030 VERIFIED in ledger with QA scheduler evidence (commits `99eb38de4`/`64345845a`/`347366c72`, live QA runs)
3. Retry owner password reset email (429 quota)
4. Deliver 2-hour report #5
5. Queue: APK rebuild so dashboard + auth/QA sections reach device; verify scheduler intervals persist across Render restarts; iOS Command Center guardian wiring (secondary)

## Critical Context
- Production: `https://api.ivxholding.com`; deployed HEAD `347366c72` (QA scheduler live, verified ~21:07 UTC); Render service `srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0`; repo `ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest` main
- `/health` sha at `seniorDeveloperRuntime.commitSha`; deployId from render_trigger_deploy is null — poll health ~1–2 min
- Guardian exports (added `99eb38de4`): `runAuthProbes`, `reconcileIncidents` (returns `GuardianIncident[]` newly opened), `resolveAlertPhone`, `maskPhone`, `smsProviderStatus`, `GUARDIAN_STATE_FILE_PATH`, `EMPTY_GUARDIAN_STATE`, types `ProbeResult`/`GuardianIncident`/`AlertLogEntry`/`GuardianState`
- `ivx-sns-sms.ts`: `sendSnsSms({to,message,senderId})` → `{ok,status:'sent'|'missing_config'|'rate_limited'|'failed',messageId,httpStatus,missingEnvNames,error,sentAt}`
- `ivx-durable-store.ts`: `readDurableJson<T>(file,fallback)`, `writeDurableJson(file,value)`
- `owner-only.ts`: `assertIVXOwnerOnly` throws → `ownerOnlyJson({ok:false,error},401)`; CORS origin `https://ivxholding.com`
- `getIVXAccessToken` at `expo/lib/
